versions.name: Bugling
versions.description: Sound ten standard calls, from Reveille to Taps, know when each one is used, compose a call of your own for your troop, and serve as its bugler for three months.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
